learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basics of data protection law.
Students can analyze data processing operations regarding the relevance of data protection law.
Students can apply solution patterns to design systems in a privacy-friendly and data protection law-compliant manner.

syllabus_topics: What is data protection, informational self-determination, and privacy?
What are the consequences of processing personal data? Where do these consequences arise from?
What are the principles of data protection?
What rights do data subjects have?
What happens to personal data in networked systems?
What organizational and technical measures help to secure personal data?
What is Privacy by Design and how can it be implemented?
Special areas of data processing: telecommunications, economy, medicine
teaching_methods: Exercises for knowledge and understanding checks
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon passing the written exam.
